description: Retrieve v2 command execution logs for a test session. Returns structured JSON with enhanced detail compared to v1 logs. Web automation (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) only: an app automation session returns not found; listMobileSessions carries the video and screenshot links of app sessions.

sessionId.description: The web automation test ID (e.g. DA-WIN-...) or session ID

name: getSessionV2CommandLogs
title: Get Session V2 Command Logs
